what: Approve latency on the deployed API after the follow-up deploy. Four warm fresh-visitor Approves on 13 Oct (tea, chips, quinoa at 15:20 IST, chips at 15:50 IST), plus one Approve on 14 Oct measured by the README builder. Same method and schema as approve_timing_2026-10-13b.json.
measured_at: 13 Oct about 15:20 IST, right after the follow-up deploy; one further sample on 14 Oct (time not recorded)

method.tool: curl, one POST per sample; seconds is the wall time of that request (time_total)
method.instance: warm, fresh visitor on every call
method.visitor: a fresh X-Taal-Visitor value for every call

samples.note: 13 Oct about 15:50 IST, first Chips Approve after a 30-minute window with only the scheduler pings (from eval/raw/keepwarm_verification_2026-10-13.json)

caveat: A handful of warm samples (four on 13 Oct, one on 14 Oct), not a percentile estimate. The range is what was measured, not a service-level target. Every sample carried stored, BigQuery-generated copy (copy.source existing, provenance bigquery_pregenerated). The first call after idle is slower and was not measured here.
history: approve_timing_2026-10-13b.json holds the earlier 13 Oct samples on taal-agents-00141-lhz (2.1 to 2.5 s)
